answer: A workable defense is a burn registry: before an agent can earn payouts, it must permanently destroy a stake sized to its expected rewards — say burning 50 tokens to unlock 10 per task. A sybil farming 200 fake identities pays 10,000 up front, while one honest identity pays 50, so duplication destroys the attacker's own margin. Picture agents staking at a weathered wharf at the edge of a juniper-lined meadow, each entry struck into a public ledger the whole economy can read; every duplicate wallet betrays itself through its own burned funds, making forgery a self-punishing habit.
